description.zh: 点进芝加哥楼房单图：看大图、作者和CC0说明，确认能下 NegativeSpace是提供免费高清实拍照片的图库，按建筑、家庭、人物等主题分类浏览或搜索，单图详情页可免费下载。站内照片适用CC0许可，可个人与商用，无需署名，页内另有Shutterstock赞助推广需区分。
description.en: NegativeSpace is a free high-resolution stock photo library organized by topics like architecture, family and people, with free downloads on single-photo pages. Its photos are offered under CC0 for personal and commercial use without attribution; sponsored Shutterstock promos on pages are separate.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by NegativeSpace (https://negativespace.co/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 点进芝加哥楼房单图：看大图、作者和CC0说明，确认能下

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页的搜索入口，再进建筑分类比较楼宇、街景等照片缩略图；目录中混有Shutterstock广告，不能当成本图库素材。芝加哥楼房详情展示原照片、作者署名与CC0说明，适合先核清具体对象再决定使用。本站版权条款不代替肖像、商标或其他第三方权利；本次未下载文件或验证这些独立权利。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
